title: Patch: the Marketplace
thread:
**Issue #1853 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #1853: Patch: the Marketplace
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

Phase 0 of the Stinkyscape set: a mechanic merged on `main` without the set. No card reaches it until fullsend 1 ships the set; its Stinkyscape cards are built later, in S21, S25.

## The rule

Built on the night market's shop prompt (Meditative #42 CN Flea Market, R1000) and on the Resources and Credits of #1840:

- It opens for both players the first time either gains a Resource or Credits, so a game with no
  Stinkyscape card never sees it. One offering for both players, a stock for each; you buy in your main
  phase from a button, for Credits and no mana; a Resource bought goes to the tray.
- The offering re-rolls every 6 turns, by a table of lots, each a pool and a count, with a stock range:
  four of the Resources (stock 4–8), three of the twelve v3–v5 Weapons, both Warp Disruptors, both
  Scanning Probes (stock 6 and 3), two Drone Cores, one Launcher, two Starship Pieces, two Stinkyscape
  cards and one of the 10 AI cards (stock 1–3 for the rest). The table is the set's data (S21); the
  mechanic reads any table, and its tests use a fixture table.
- **Prices** (the designer's rule): a card of cost c costs **10 × min(c, 4) + 5 × max(c − 4, 0)** Credits,
  and a (0) card 5, so (4) is 40 and (5) 45. A lot is Radiant 20% of the time, at twice the price. Prices
  move every turn, drawn around that price with a spread of a tenth of it; Resources' buy prices never
  move, and their sell prices move within their printed ranges.
- A lot can be added for the rest of the game at a fixed price (Call to Chaos (Scape Edition): a Call to
  Chaos at 20).

## Done when

- The rule is an engine primitive (`crates/engine`), proved on fixture scripts (`crates/engine/tests/rules/fixtures/`, the `testkit`'s `scenario()`), its edges included. No Stinkyscape card is needed or added: the cards come later, behind the set's gate.
- Its §6 row (and §10 where it touches it), and ruling notes from this issue's block, R(N×1000) up, each named after its proving test (CLAUDE.md rule 3); `cargo jackioh spec index` and `cargo jackioh spec check`.
- A new event has its `ANIMATIONS` and `SOUND_CUES` rows; the market's prompt and actions are answered by `crates/ai`, the random policy and the timeout, and `legalActions`, the reducer's refusal and the view agree.
- The client's shop (from the night market's) renders `viewFor` alone (CLAUDE.md rule 7).
- New state is optional and skipped when absent, so no shipped game changes: no golden trace moves and `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main` names no card that plays differently (plan D3).
- Every number is a named constant (CLAUDE.md rule 9) and the pure crates stay pure (rule 4): every price move and roll is drawn from the match's `Rng`.
- The gates: `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo test --workspace --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts`, `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `patches check`, `spec check`, `fuzz --seeds 200`, and the web's typecheck and tests where the client changed.

The plan: [`docs/stinkyscape-set.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/stoic-planck-f1rvyy/docs/stinkyscape-set.md) (ST3, ST5, ST9); the designer's list: [`JackiOh_Stinkyscape_Cards.md`](https://github.com/jlore-studios/jackioh/blob/claude/stoic-planck-f1rvyy/JackiOh_Stinkyscape_Cards.md). Both are on the planning branch `claude/stoic-planck-f1rvyy` until they merge; where they disagree with SPEC, SPEC wins (CLAUDE.md).

Blocked by #1840

Part of #1836.
```

handoff.draft:
**Goal.** Stinkyscape's Marketplace becomes an engine primitive on fixture scripts, reached by no shipped card. It opens for both players on the first Resource or Credits gained (`GameState.marketplace`, absent until then, so no golden moves). It holds one offering rolled from a table of lots (re-rolled every 6 turns), a stock per player, prices by the designer's rule (20% Radiant at 2×, moving every turn by up to a tenth; Resources' buy prices fixed, their sell quotes redrawn each turn in range) and fixed-price lots added for the rest of the game. A player buys (and sells tray Resources) in their own main phase with two new actions, for Credits and no mana. `legalActions`, the reducer's refusal and `view_for` read one function each. The AI, the random policy and the timeout handle the actions, the client's shop renders the view alone, and the spec, the rulings R1853000–R1853005 and the events' rows come in the same change.

**Decisions the issue left open** (each goes into a ruling note; reject the alternative named):
- D-a. **Direct actions, no prompt**: `marketBuy { offer }` and `marketSell { instanceId }`, each listed while its refusal passes, as `trade` is (R1838000). Rejected: a button action opening a `market` prompt with Leave. An open-then-Leave pair changes nothing, and the random policy, the fuzz and the AI could repeat it without end. "Built on the night market" is kept for the prices' shape and the shop's look (`market.css`, `MarketPrompt.tsx`'s card face).
- D-b. Selling is in: the designer's list says Resources "can be sold or bought on the Marketplace". A sale fetches the Resource's quote this turn. Once the Marketplace is open, the full-tray sale (R1840001) fetches the quote too and draws nothing.
- D-c. "Every 6 turns" counts game turns (`state.turn`), so 3 of each player's. Rejected: six of each player's.
- D-d. The spread is a uniform whole-number draw in [p − ⌊p/10⌋, p + ⌊p/10⌋], with no draw when ⌊p/10⌋ is 0. Rejected: a normal draw (floats).
- D-e. A Radiant Resource lot costs its Radiant face's printed `buy`, not 2× the base one.
- D-f. A buy is refused when the hand (or, for a Resource, the tray) is full, as the night market offers no lot to a full hand. Rejected: burn or auto-sell.
- D-g. Everything at the Marketplace is public: the offering, prices and a public `marketBought` naming the card. Credits are already public (R1840005) and the prices tell the offers apart. The card itself arrives through `addedToHand`/`resourceGained`, hidden per R97. The view sends only the viewer's own stock and sales.
- D-h. A fixed lot (`add_market_lot`) is offered to its caster alone. Its price never moves, it survives every re-roll, and its stock is `MARKETPLACE_FIXED_LOT_STOCK` (1) a cycle. Adding one opens the Marketplace if it is closed.
- D-i. The production table `MARKETPLACE_TABLE` stays empty until S21 fills it. Tests set a fixture table through a testkit override. No fold reads the table (no carried version gains Resources). The patch that ships the set's table owes each version its own (as R1846003).
- D-j. Opening emits no event. The client shows the shop from `view.marketplace`, so #1840's exact-event tests stay green.

**Files to touch.**
